purpose: Current research continuation bundle; validation is not a formal proof or external peer review.

manuscript_status.publication_status: public-facing research draft, not published or peer reviewed
manuscript_status.newness: Primary sources and exact applicable statements checked; comprehensive novelty is not asserted.
manuscript_status.universal_AS_cubic_existence: Disproved by a smooth Calabi-Yau Zhang-twist example in Theorem 10.6.
manuscript_status.specified_Poisson_quantization_family: General finite-parameter existence remains open; formal, etale-local, and explicit block cases are separated.
manuscript_status.relative_saturation_reduction: Proved conditionally under RB1-RB2, relative exceptional SOD and proper dg model; smoothness C iff residual smoothness; no general relative diagonal lift constructed.
manuscript_status.relative_rotation_periodicity: Formal identity (1)^3=[2] in graded matrix factorizations. Transfer to residual category conditional on relative Orlov equivalence.
manuscript_status.complete_intersection_existence: Section 2: over C smooth ordinary projective CI dim>=3, nonzero Poisson iff Pn, quadric, cubic, or (2,2); relies on classical Brueckmann vanishing.
manuscript_status.toric_homogeneous: Section 2: toric dim>=2 (normal as Poisson derivations, smooth as bivector) and smooth projective homogeneous dim>=2
manuscript_status.quantization: Quadratic relations explicit via cyclic potential; central cubic algebraizable from kernel in general; explicit closed formula in Fermat case.
manuscript_status.hesse_explicit_center: Closed polynomial central cubic for smooth Hesse f=(S/3)+txyz, t^3 != -1, derived from Smith-Tate / De Laet-Le Bruyn; general mixed center terms remain open.
manuscript_status.hesse_discriminant: Explicit nonzero Zariski open containing h=0 defined by U(h,t)*(1-h^2*t^2/4)*Delta(h,t).
